// A sibling `tests.rs` carries no `#[cfg(test)]` of its own: the parent
// declares it. The whole file is test code.
use super::*;

#[test]
fn sibling_file_is_test_context() {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("SIBLING_FILE", "1") };
}

#[test]
#[serial_test::serial(sibling_env)]
fn a_justified_call_is_not_reported() {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("SIBLING_JUSTIFIED", "1") }; // env-ok: serialised by serial(sibling_env)
}

#[test]
fn a_hand_rolled_exec_write_is_reported() {
    std::fs::set_permissions("sibling-stub", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn a_marked_mode_is_not_reported() {
    // exec-writer-ok: 0o700 on a directory, which is never exec'd.
    std::fs::set_permissions("gnupghome", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn an_open_options_exec_write_is_reported() {
    let _ = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().mode(0o755).write(true).open("opts-stub");
}
